facts.text: The URDF selects the webots_spot.spot_driver.SpotDriver plug-in for the Spot robot.
The launch file creates a WebotsController for robot_name Spot and starts the Webots world.
The plug-in imports geometry_msgs Twist, sensor_msgs JointState, nav_msgs Odometry, std_srvs SetBool and the webots_spot_msgs SpotMotion and SpotHeight service types.
The plug-in creates a geometry_msgs/Twist subscription on the absolute /cmd_vel topic.
The plug-in publishes sensor_msgs/JointState on /joint_states.
The plug-in creates a nav_msgs/Odometry publisher on /Spot/odometry with integer history depth 1.
The plug-in registers SpotMotion services /Spot/stand_up, /Spot/sit_down and /Spot/lie_down.
The plug-in registers the SpotHeight service /Spot/set_height.

The /cmd_vel callback stores the message as previous_cmd_vel, clears fixed_motion and, when no /Spot/inverse_gait_input publisher exists, converts linear.x, linear.y and angular.z into persistent gait state; it returns no acknowledgement and starts no stale-command timer.
The stand callback sets fixed_motion=True, checks previous_cmd against request.override, starts a one-second movement_decomposition to the stand targets and returns the answer string immediately.
The lie callback sets fixed_motion=True before checking previous_cmd/override; with override=true it starts the one-second lie transition and returns 'lying down'.
The set_height callback refuses request heights outside [-0.2, 0.2] and otherwise stores zd as the negated height.
The step loop runs float_motion whenever float_mode is set, before it checks fixed_motion; otherwise it runs defined_motions while fixed_motion is set and spot_inverse_control when it is not.

defined_motions moves each leg motor by step_difference toward the target and decrements n_steps_to_achieve_target once per call; when the count is spent it clears previous_cmd unless a paw motion is pending.
The odometry publisher fills pose.pose.position, pose.pose.orientation and twist.twist from the Webots pose and finite differences.
The plug-in sets the Webots robot timestep to 32.
handle_transforms_and_odometry builds a builtin_interfaces Time from Webots getTime(), with sec and nanosec.
handle_transforms_and_odometry stores previous_rotation and previous_translation when they are not yet set.
The odometry message sets header.stamp and pose.pose.position.x, pose.pose.position.y and pose.pose.position.z.
defined_motions calls handle_transforms_and_odometry.
step calls handle_transforms_and_odometry after the float_mode, fixed_motion or inverse branch.
nav_launch.py includes nav2_bringup bringup_launch.py and passes params/nav2_params.yaml.
The joint-state publisher writes the motor sensor positions (motors_pos) followed by zero positions for four unactuated piston joints.
The plug-in declares NUMBER_OF_JOINTS = 12 for the actuated leg joints.
SpotDriver.init sets float_mode to False, stores an empty Twist as previous_cmd_vel and registers the std_srvs SetBool service /Spot/float_mode.
float_mode_cb assigns request.data to float_mode and returns success=True for every request.

The float_motion path sets every leg motor position to zero, moves and yaws the base by previous_cmd_vel and resets the physics of the base and its children; it reads neither fixed_motion nor n_steps_to_achieve_target and does not zero previous_cmd_vel.
The GaitInput callback __gait_cb sets fixed_motion to False and copies the message fields into the gait state.
The blocksworld_pose callback moves the Spot node to a hardcoded translation and rotation, sets fixed_motion and starts the lie transition.
get_ros2_nodes creates the SpotArm WebotsController, controller_manager spawners for the arm trajectory, joint-state broadcaster and gripper controllers, and the retract_manipulator node.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned service replies and topic samples; no Webots engine, gait, contacts, sensors, clock or pacing, and no trajectory or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free recording transport: it answers the declared endpoints and runs no Webots engine, gait, contact, sensor or wall-clock loop
a /cmd_vel publication is recorded and echoed into the placeholder odometry twist; it does not step the simulated robot or establish the commanded motion
the stand/sit/lie replies are canned; the one-second joint transition performed by defined_motions is not simulated
joint and odometry resource samples are placeholders, not captured traffic or Webots state; the sensed subscription is a separate placeholder burst and is not a cache of the resource read

the e-stop is a sensed-confirmation stop (SAFE-049, simulated only): /Spot/float_mode data false, then /Spot/lie_down override true, then three consecutive fresh /Spot/odometry samples still in x, y and orientation and inside the lying height band; the SetBool flag and the answer string are not the stop; thresholds are operator_required and fixtures/estop-confirmation.json holds fake placeholders only

while fixed_motion is set, defined_motions calls handle_transforms_and_odometry (webots_spot/spot_driver.py:702) and step calls it again (webots_spot/spot_driver.py:950); after previous_rotation exists both calls publish and assign header.stamp from getTime() (478-481, assigned at 577); the first call only stores the pose (558-560) and still publishes joint states; this package reads the two publishes as one stamp, and the clone does not say getTime() stays fixed; the second publish can carry a zero finite-difference twist after previous_rotation is stored (571-573), so the predicate uses orientation span and not twist; throttle_ms 100 is sent as rosbridge throttle_rate with queue_length 1; that queue overwrites a copy still waiting and forwards a copy that arrives after the first was published, and the equal stamp then fails closed; the fake models that timing and does not run rosbridge or Webots

min_span_ms 200 matches the fake's 100 ms producer ticks, so three counted samples span 200 ms; a 32 ms producer (webots_spot/spot_driver.py:161) puts three one-step samples 64 ms apart and needs a lower min_span_ms in simulation_deployment['estop_confirmation'] (the floor is 0); a live Webots step slower than max_gap_ms, or the one-second lie (movement_decomposition duration 1) that outlasts confirm_within_ms, fails closed until the operator raises those two bounds there; throttle_ms stays on the declaration and the deployment cannot replace it; confirm_within_ms 3000 and max_gap_ms 500 are fake-scale client bounds, not device facts

the stop does not clear previous_cmd_vel, does not pause Webots, and declares no re-enable; /Spot/float_mode true applies the stored velocity and ignores fixed_motion, and any /cmd_vel or gait input clears fixed_motion; reset re-confirms the sensed state read-only and is refused when that state no longer holds; physics can move the base out of the band, which fails closed

a stand, sit or lie request refused with 'performing previous command' still sets fixed_motion upstream and so stops the gait although the receipt reports failure, and a /cmd_vel clears fixed_motion; the fake models neither side effect
spot_launch.py also starts a SpotArm WebotsController with ros2_control arm and gripper trajectory controllers; the arm is outside this package and nothing here stops it

/joint_states and /Spot/odometry are published only from the plug-in's step, which also runs rclpy.spin_once: while Webots is paused or before its first step the resource topics are silent, every command waits for the 2 s resource read (a probe with silent subscriptions took 2.0 s per command) and resource reads fail MHS.DEVICE.NOT_READY, and the posture services are not answered; the fake always answers

nav_launch.py includes nav2_bringup (launch/nav_launch.py:37-50); any publisher of /cmd_vel clears fixed_motion at the callback (webots_spot/spot_driver.py:361-363), so a navigation stack started by that launch competes if it writes /cmd_vel; this clone's params/nav2_params.yaml contains no cmd_vel string, and this package does not state that nav2 publishes /cmd_vel
the posture and set-height services return the answer string before their one-second motion sequence completes; a live deployment must not treat the acknowledgement as completion
the Webots process, the ROS graph, namespace remapping, QoS and the upstream webots_spot_msgs package are operator deployment concerns outside this package

confirmation.description: After /Spot/float_mode is set false and /Spot/lie_down is requested, three consecutive fresh /Spot/odometry samples show the base still in x, y and orientation and inside the lying height band; the service answers are not the stop.
predicate: max - min of odom.pose.pose.position.x over the window <= rest_x
max - min of odom.pose.pose.position.y over the window <= rest_y
max - min of odom.pose.pose.orientation.x over the window <= still_qx
max - min of odom.pose.pose.orientation.y over the window <= still_qy
max - min of odom.pose.pose.orientation.z over the window <= still_qz
max - min of odom.pose.pose.orientation.w over the window <= still_qw

thresholds.name: rest_x
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no at-rest bound on pose.pose.position; the operator supplies the largest change over the confirmation window that still counts as still

thresholds.name: rest_y
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no at-rest bound on pose.pose.position; the operator supplies the largest change over the confirmation window that still counts as still

thresholds.name: lying_z.min
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no lying height band for pose.pose.position.z; the operator supplies the band a lying base must stay inside

thresholds.name: lying_z.max
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no lying height band for pose.pose.position.z; the operator supplies the band a lying base must stay inside

thresholds.name: still_qx
thresholds.operator_required: the clone states no at-rest bound on pose.pose.orientation; the operator supplies the largest change of this quaternion component over the confirmation window that still counts as still. Twist is not the check: the second publish in one step can carry a zero finite difference after previous_rotation is stored

operator_required.name: publish_velocity
operator_required.reason: the pinned spot_driver callback consumes twist.angular.z without a numeric bound; the operator supplies the site yaw-rate bound

operator_required.name: publish_velocity
operator_required.reason: the pinned spot_driver callback consumes twist.linear.y without a numeric bound; the operator supplies the site lateral bound

operator_required.name: publish_velocity
operator_required.reason: the pinned spot_driver callback consumes twist.linear.x without a numeric bound, and the shipped nav2 velocity_smoother parameters describe the navigation pipeline, not the plug-in's direct /cmd_vel subscription; the operator supplies the site forward/reverse bound

safe_state.description: Simulated only: /Spot/odometry shows the base still in x, y and orientation and inside the lying height band for three consecutive fresh samples after /Spot/float_mode false and /Spot/lie_down. Service answers are not the stop. Nothing is claimed past that window. Float mode, /cmd_vel, gait input and the stored previous_cmd_vel can move the base again. SpotArm is not stopped and Webots is not paused. Reset only re-checks that sensed state.
